facts.statement: Virtusa Corporation is a global provider of digital engineering and IT outsourcing services.
Virtusa was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Southborough, Massachusetts, USA.
Virtusa was listed on NASDAQ (ticker VRTU) until 2021, when it was acquired by funds affiliated with Baring Private Equity Asia and became privately held.
Virtusa delivers services from centers in India, including Hyderabad and Chennai, and in Sri Lanka, in Colombo.
Virtusa serves clients in banking, financial services and insurance; healthcare and life sciences; and communications, media and technology.
Virtusa's services include digital engineering, cloud transformation, data and analytics, application development and maintenance, and IT consulting.
